ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels are restricted to a continuous border along the trailing edge and specific markings at the central base and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black band along the trailing edge; a small, high-contrast black spot on the left distal lobe; three vertically-aligned, horizontal black dash-like markings located centrally above the notch; yellowish-brown textured clusters localized at the far tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel-based angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude, low-frequency irregularities; visible pixel-level serrations are most prominent on the medial portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a moderate concavity tapering from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of heterogeneous, high-frequency texture (barnacles) on the extreme outer tips of both lobes; no distinct white circular scars are visible on the interior white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant bio-fouling/barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips creating an irregular, jagged profile compared to the smooth trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct, horizontally-oriented black dashes arranged in a vertical stack at the central base of the fluke, just above the notch.
